note: The species the marine-life catalog promises to cover: one denominator per group, each held at 80% by src/content/coverage.test.ts. Built from REEF and iNaturalist counts used only to choose species; no frequency is shown in the product.

groups.method: Every species REEF volunteer surveys sighted on at least 10% of dives in at least one Florida or Caribbean region with 500 or more surveys (REEF Geographic Zone Reports, all years to 2026-10-14). Look-alike complexes REEF lumps count once; unidentified and hybrid entries are left out.
